lines.text: Nope. The air is holding it shut.
The air? The air is on my side!
There's a vacuum inside. Less air in the jar than out here.
So all the air outside is pressing the lid down onto the glass.
The sky is in on it?!
That push jams the seal tight, so twisting fights a lot of friction.
So let the air in. Slide a spoon under the edge of the lid and lift gently.
When it hisses, the seal is broken.
Still stuck? Run hot tap water on the metal lid. Metal grows more than glass when it heats up.
The lid loosens just a hair. Then twist.
So I lost a fight to the sky.
Every time. And now you know.
